title: fix(auth): show SIWC email and selected model account identity
body:
Follow-up to the merged #148567, rebased onto `main`. This PR contains only the two account-identity commits.

## What Problem This Solves

SIWC connections omit the signed-in email, and the composer hides account identity behind a generic subscription label, making multiple credentials hard to distinguish.

## User Impact

The provider screen can show the SIWC email. The composer's selected account shows email and sign-in method, such as `account@example.test · Sign in with ChatGPT`, with readable account rows on desktop and mobile. Existing profiles pick up email on their next token refresh, or by reconnecting.

Automatic selection remains explicit: this describes the selected account, not which credential ultimately served or billed a request. Other people's private account details remain hidden.

## Why This Change Was Made

The SIWC parser discarded the email claim from the verified ID token. This saves that claim through the existing credential metadata, reuses it when refresh omits a new ID token, and replaces it when a new token is supplied. Account labels now include both existing email and display name, and the UI no longer suppresses identity when only one account exists.

No credential ownership, account-binding, routing, schema, or permission changes. The incremental diff is nine files and 17 net production lines; the rest is focused regression coverage.

## Evidence

- Rebased onto `main` at `3813c048eb7`; `git range-diff` confirms both follow-up patches are unchanged. Fresh correctness/privacy and design/maintainability reviews of `8a0978f46d8` found no actionable code issues.
- Post-rebase validation: 33 OAuth tests and 33 account-store/gateway metadata tests pass (102.07s across three routed shards), covering email backfill/replacement, account binding, owner isolation, and session selection. All 404 chat/catalog UI tests pass (12.86s). Earlier session-control and provider-profile suites also passed.
- Desktop (1280px) and phone (390px) browser cases pass. The overlap assertion fails against the original CSS and passes after repair; identity assertions also reproduced the earlier missing-label behavior.
- Core, plugin, and UI production type checks, targeted lint, stylelint, and formatting passed before the patch-identical rebase; the final diff whitespace check passes.
- Browser screenshots use the real Control UI with a simulated Gateway and synthetic accounts. Live SIWC sign-in/refresh and the rebuilt Mac app were not repeated for this metadata/display change.

Before-merge proof still outstanding: live SIWC email reaching the saved credential and selected account, plus the matching before screenshot comparison. The existing after captures were delivered in the originating task.

Screenshots were inspected locally and GitHub accepted both uploads. GitHub CDN rendering could not be verified from this environment because the TLS connection ended unexpectedly.
